{{Top|leg}}
'''Galaxeed''' was a colony located in the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]].<ref name="note">Galaxeed is identified as one of the teams participating in the [[Roon Colonial Games]] in "[[The Roon Games]]" and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' states that the competing teams represent colonies of the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]].</ref> A Galaxeed team competed against teams representing [[Umboo]] and [[Tawntoom]] in the [[Roon Colonial Games]]<ref name="TRG">{{DroidsCite|The Roon Games}}</ref> in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="Polyhedron170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref>
